from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,tarfile,hashlib,json,datetime,traceback
v=Path('/workspaces/.agent-state/kprog-lanes/V');folder=v/'reference-models/acl2-packages';roots=[v/'reference-models'/n for n in ['acl2-root','acl2-8.7-root','acl2-8.7-sbcl-build']];entries=[];rc=1
h=lambda p:hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
try:
 for package in sorted(folder.glob('*.deb')):
  assert package.resolve().parent==folder.resolve() and not package.is_symlink()
  size=package.stat().st_size;digest=h(package);matched=0;issues=[]
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['dpkg-deb','--fsys-tarfile',str(package)],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
  with tarfile.open(fileobj=proc.stdout,mode='r|') as archive:
   for member in archive:
    if not member.isfile():continue
    rel=Path(member.name)
    assert not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts
    with archive.extractfile(member) as stream:expected=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
    found=False
    for root in roots:
     target=root/rel
     if target.is_file() and target.stat().st_size==member.size and h(target)==expected:found=True;break
    if found:matched+=1
    else:issues.append(str(rel))
  assert proc.wait()==0
  row=dict(path=str(package),bytes=size,sha256=digest,regular_members_verified=matched,unmatched_members=issues,retired=False)
  if not issues:
   assert matched>0 and h(package)==digest;package.unlink();row['retired']=True
  entries.append(row)
  (v/'notes/acl2-download-cache-retirement.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='Private downloaded deb copies only. Installed official model engines, sources, certificates and shared incremental caches retained. Each retired package regular member matches a retained installed byte sequence.',entries=entries,reclaimed_bytes=sum(e['bytes']for e in entries if e['retired'])),indent=2)+'\n')
  print(package.name,'retired'if row['retired']else'retained unmatched',matched,len(issues),flush=True)
 rc=0
except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
finally:(v/'retire-acl2-download-cache.exit').write_text(str(rc)+'\n')
raise SystemExit(rc)

(define default-cpuid-flag-fn ((eax  :type (unsigned-byte 32))
                                 (ecx  :type (unsigned-byte 32))
                                 (reg   (or (equal reg #.*eax*)
                                            (equal reg #.*ebx*)
                                            (equal reg #.*ecx*)
                                            (equal reg #.*edx*)))
                                 (bit   :type (integer 0 63))
                                 (width :type (integer 1 32)))
    :ignore-ok t

    ;; Let's have everything enabled by default, just to see what breaks and when.

    (case eax

      (#ux8000_0008
       (case reg
         (#.*eax*
          (case bit
            (0 (if (equal width 8)
                   52 ;; MAXPHYADDR
                 0))
            (8 (if (equal width 8)
                   48 ;; LINEARADDR
                 0))
            (t 0)))
         (t 1))) ;; EAX = #ux8000_0008

      (t 1)))
